turns.question: 哪些用户可以对订单发起自助退款？
turns.finding: The question varied only the initiating actor, so the single-policy-axis candidate passed execution. The exact server-side ownership enforcement was absent from the options, so strict Other was appropriate.

turns.question: 支付退款调用失败后订单保持原状态还是进入待人工处理？
turns.finding: The question did not distinguish unknown timeout from deterministic gateway failure, so the user supplied two different outcomes and no option represented the complete policy.

candidateGate.acceptedBecause: The first real GLM-5.1 question varied only the initiating actor and did not bundle amount, state, or time-window choices.
candidateGate.rejectedBecause: Both useful free-form answers remained selectedOption=other; finalRequirementCoverage stayed 0 and no typed disposition could be synthesized.
candidateGate.replacement: Add a runtime-governed one-time Other normalization confirmation bound to the prior redacted event, and require failure candidates to identify one explicit failure class.
